messages:
maria: Heads-up: JS SDK publish blocked by a regen diff after the semver bump. CI failed on typegen.
ci-bot: [CI] job 5782 failed: https://ci.redwood/jobs/5782 56artifact: /artifacts/typegen-regendiff-5782.txt
alex: repro locally: `yarn typegen:regen` outputs files with only key/property ordering changes. No semantic change but git diff flags it.
priyanka: The release script ran yesterday which also runs our changelog automation. I noticed some changelog entries were rewritten/moved; could that change inputs to the generator?
sam: Also seeing a sample-app e2e failure in auth/retry tests. The mock server asserts header serialization order and snapshots now fail intermittently.
tobias: Ordering-only diffs should be normalized. Is the nondeterminism in the OpenAPI source, our generator printer, or the post-processing step?
alex: digging in  found the changelog step mutates examples in the OpenAPI doc and currently uses Node's object iteration order from a traversal over git tree entries. Semver bump altered commit ordering so traversal order changed -> different key insertion order in the doc.
yang: Yikes. Short-term mitigation: add a deterministic key sort before codegen printing. Longer term we should remove any dependence on git traversal order.
priyanka: Also request we add a CI guard: a lightweight `yarn typegen:check` that runs in PRs and fails early if regen would change files. Catches this before merge.
alex: I have a 6-line patch that sorts object keys in the generator. Will open PR and add the check to the devex CI job.
ci-bot: [CI] rerun requested by alex 56job 5785 queued.
maria: Can we also make the sample-app tests resilient to header ordering? Mock server should compare headers case-insensitively and not rely on insertion order.
sam: On it  will change test assertions to use set-like comparisons.
tobias: Add a changelog checklist item: run regen after release-script steps. And add a brief note in the release runbook about this nondeterminism.
ci-bot: [CI] job 5785 passed: https://ci.redwood/jobs/5785 56no regen diff. Publish unblocked. :tada:
priyanka: Thanks all. Follow-up: create a tiny integration test that mutates changelog flow and ensures typegen output is stable.
yang: Filing a follow-up ticket for removing git-traversal dependence and for a test harness to fuzz merge-order scenarios.
maria: Great. Closing the loop once PRs land.
